Bathe in a forest of fragrant dry cedar, warm sandalwood, and fresh damp moss. Top notes of bergamot and lemon introduce the fragrance with a burst of vibrant freshness, while middle notes of earthy saffron and airy cyclamen bring a touch of floralcy and warmth to the heart.
